theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bv_set_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (m + 1))), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (Fs k)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in Fs k, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), StrictMono ψ ∧ MeasurableSet F₀ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => volume (symmDiff (Fs (ψ j)) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
